title: A message through silk
hook: A web can carry movement as well as catch prey.

knows: A stretched thread can move when disturbed.
doesNotKnow: Relate a web disturbance to vibration along silk.

misconception: A web is only a container and cannot transmit information.
objective: Relate a web disturbance to vibration along silk.

claims.text: A web can carry movement as well as catch prey. A small object disturbs an orb web. What physical signal can travel along the silk toward the spider? The schematic shows a disturbance traveling along silk toward the spider. Web vibrations can provide information, but a vibration alone does not guarantee the spider can identify a particular prey item.

Recall: A spider senses movement transmitted along its silk web. What is traveling along the silk? Mechanical vibrations travel through the silk.
